era.title: Interstellar Civilization
era.subtitle: Humanity crosses into mythic-scale civilization among the stars
era.description: This era marks the first true interstellar civilization through Proxima settlement missions, extrasolar biospheres, peaceful contact, wormhole law, galactic archaeology, Dyson swarm construction, star-lifting, matter printing, and shared civilization among human, AI, and non-human minds.
